name: vercel-skills — JSON-first skills fork
description: A lean, zero-dependency JSON-first fork of vercel-labs/skills (skills.sh, MIT). Reimplements the upstream skill-discovery + SKILL.md parse pipeline as a single Node script (Node >=18, no pnpm/node_modules/build step) whose only contract is STRUCTURED JSON on stdout. Point it at any directory tree and it emits a clean skill catalog (name, description, path, metadata, optional body) for programmatic discovery, tool-use routing, and interop — the thing the upstream CLI's human-formatted stdout makes awkward. See REVIEW.md for the architecture review that motivated the fork.
author: LightHeart Ventures
license: MIT (fork of vercel-labs/skills, MIT) / Apache-2.0 (plugin wrapper)

upstream.divergence: JSON-first output; zero runtime deps (minimal safe frontmatter parser instead of the `yaml` package); discovery + parse only (no install/sync/telemetry/network).
